reels.title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding

editorial_notes.reasoning: High hardware efficiency multiplier (1.30x) combined with a mechanism that is visually perfect for 3b1b-style chalkboard animations involving streaming data and sparse memory.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI only 'remembered' the most important 5% of a book while reading?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A frantic librarian who only keeps the most relevant page numbers on their desk rather than the entire bookshelf.
